The assistant can call **118 tools**. Every one of them is checked against the permission gate before it runs — see [Permissions](../mechanisms/permissions.md) for what AUTO, ASK and DENY mean and who decides.

> These are the **shipped defaults**. Every value here lives in a config
> file you own once TESSERACT is installed, so your copy may differ — and
> should, once you tune it.
